_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. The five pollution kinds (spec section 2). tool: the id Lumi must own to work the kind at all ('' = none). needs_module and without_module_factor: a rig module the kind wants; without it fitted Lumi works the kind at that factor (slick without the Hover Skirt is shoreline work only). hand_factor: Lumi's rate on the kind against litter. loads: true = the work goes through the chest (tip or press, then paid per load); false = paid as it is done, with a small win every `batch` units. yield: cubes and Parts per unit cleared by hand; cubes 'kept:pollution' means the average value of the planet's current junk table, read through Planets, because the redesign keeps that table. crew_value: share of the yield a robot's work pays. mastery_per_unit and mastery_level1_units: level L needs mastery_level1_units x balance.mastery.growth^(L-1) units cleared by hand.
